parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the provided code does not contain any buffer overflow vulnerabilities. The code already checks for invalid input and handles cases where the input is intentionally malformed.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works after the change because the code already checks for invalid input and handles cases where the input is intentionally malformed. The code does not allocate memory for decoded string based on the length of the input string, but rather based on the assumption that the input is always valid base64 data. Therefore, the code does not contain any buffer overflow vulnerabilities.
